findings.concrete_fix: Choose worthwhile windows and implement through their source families; preserve integer widths, all anchors, T contacts and planes. Merge any new collinear nodes and assess pad entries. Rebuild/rebind, rerun all controls and re-extract any affected electrical models. Do not apply the copy wholesale merely to lower total length.
findings.limitation: Combined-copy CAD evidence only; windows have not been qualified individually, through production regeneration/full gate, electrically or physically. Savings do not prove a globally optimal or uniformly cleaner layout.

coverage_limits: Full assigned routing lens, not a complete substitute for the other nine lenses. No canonical build/full check.sh, production edits, git mutation, GUI launch or subagent was used.
Only own new reports and ignored probes were written. No current peer round15 report/probe was read. Root-supplied creator JPG was inspected as a named static primary source, not peer evidence.

All 116 D IDs and 22 owner mandates were considered through their current applicability index and underlying routing/owner amendments. Prior reports were context only; final numeric claims come from fresh native probes.

Source comparison dry-executes the six families actually used by r10_build.sh against current pad positions; it is not a new full native build or byte-reproducibility claim. An initial attempt to include the obsolete ports dispatcher failed on removed U411 and was corrected to the active build sequence.

The independent search enumerates exact one/two-segment alternatives in 265 fixed-anchor 2..8-segment same-width chain windows with >0.05mm excess. It uses the tool native-shape 0.16mm diagnostic screening, strict saved-pour/keep-out/edge/reference and between-pad checks. It neither explores all 3+ segment routes nor moves anchors, parts, vias, layers or planes. The 0.16mm reserve exceeds actual 0.15mm DRC and can miss valid alternatives.

Of 22 overlapping sketches, the BUZZ_G window that bypassed an unsplit T contact was rejected by genuine candidate-A DRC (1 dangling/1 unconnected, parity0). The extra tiny GND sketch and redundant overlapping variants were not qualified. These sketches are not extra production information instances.

Candidate B passed DRC but an own JSON round-trip produced 1nm width differences and synthetic neck-downs. Candidate C reconstructs original integer widths and passed the stated fresh readers/route checks/DRC. The copy writer produced a post-save native SWIG teardown failure (139); no passing writer/build result is claimed. Its output was subsequently reloaded and independently checked by native API and the genuine 10.0.7 CLI.
Candidate-B API route scan was inadvertently launched before its DRC completed; that short heavy-process overlap was disclosed to root. Subsequent corrected-copy heavy checks were sequential.

Native plots were generated from this target and all four copper layers inspected. Existing r10_copper plots bound to 0c50b9fd were not used as current evidence. Initial SVG rasterization methods failed; a temporary own rendering environment produced the inspected images and was removed afterward.

Initial web/urllib attempts to fetch the creator photo failed (tool error/HTTP403); root supplied exact primary bytes and their SHA was verified. Complete relevant maker PDF pages were rendered with Poppler and inspected fresh.

The target itself was not separately CLI-DRC checked by this lens. Genuine DRC results stated here belong to ignored copies; root/other lenses own full target integration DRC. No CAD/simulation result certifies physical or firmware behavior.
